Container.Name: NSMPerformanceValidator
Container.Overview: Tracks progress on a Norwegian Singles Method training plan from intervals.icu data. Syncs Planned Workouts and running Activities into SQLite on start and every SYNC_INTERVAL. The app has no login, so keep it on the LAN.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the page and the API are served on.

Config.Name: intervals.icu Athlete ID
Config.Description: Your intervals.icu athlete ID, e.g. i12345 (Settings → Developer Settings).

Config.Name: intervals.icu API Key
Config.Description: Your intervals.icu API key (Settings → Developer Settings). Only the server reads it.

Config.Name: Sync Interval
Config.Description: Time between scheduled syncs, e.g. 30m, 1h or 90s; a bare number is minutes.

Config.Name: LT1 HR
Config.Description: Your LT1 heart rate in bpm from a test, e.g. 155. Leave empty to assume 88% of LTHR.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone that "today" and Training Weeks follow, e.g. Europe/Oslo.
